camera_height_m: 0.55, at her kneeling eye-line at the little door's threshold
start_frame: Her POV through the open 0.38 m door: a narrow stone crawl passage not much larger than a rat-hole with iron ribs along it, and at its far end the small sunlit garden arch — beds of bright flowers and cool fountains — sitting flat and small in the frame.
end_frame: The identical frame held for the full five seconds: the passage walls and the far arch all sharp together, the garden no nearer and no larger than when the shot began.
constraint_honoured: 'The dream's one long lens, spent here and deliberately flat… must not read as somewhere we could walk into' — and the dof_policy bars any rack or defocus, so the flatness comes from the lens alone.
movement_note: POV 5 of 7 and the episode's only 100 mm. A push in on the garden would promise reachability, which is exactly the lie the scene cannot tell.
